listing.name: Perfect Dark Zero — PerfectDarkZeroRecomp (nikolaygorb)
listing.summary: The project describes the game as fully playable with audio, achievements and saves. Its Linux test statements conflict, and Portcove has not confirmed them. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own complete extracted PAL game files, including default.xex, for title 4D5307D3 and media 750FF1D9. This guide does not specify the exact supported revision or checksum; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The recorded review found release 1.8 packages. Alternatively, generate C++ and build from source with CMake, Clang and Ninja. Windows is documented as tested. The README calls Linux playable but later says only Windows was tested; Linux support remains unclear. Mac build presets do not establish that the game works on macOS.

warnings: The project describes the game as fully playable with audio, achievements and saves. Its Linux test statements conflict, and Portcove has not confirmed them.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
